dialog.body: Hello! Thank you for contacting Old Stone Auto Insurance. My name is Dylan Brooks. May I please have your name?
Hello Dylan, my name is Margaret Howard.
Nice to meet you, Margaret! Can you please provide me with your date of birth?
Sure, I was born on the seventeenth of May, nineteen eighty-five.
Thank you, Margaret. Could you also provide me with your home address for our records?
Of course, my home address is two four six Pine Street, New York, NY.
Great, I have noted down your information, Margaret. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all for now. Thank you, Dylan.
You're welcome, Margaret. Thank you for reaching out to Old Stone Auto Insurance. Have a wonderful day!
